newsitem.title: UK: Two Brent dates kept, third still moving - trade.
newsitem.headline: Two Brent dates kept, third still moving - trade.

text.p: Two of the three Brent crude cargoes nominated from the paper chains on Friday have been kept ahead of the five o'clock deadline, traders said.
One cargo was kept by Vitol and the other by Shell UK, they said.
A third date was still going through the chains. The cargoes are due to load March 29-31
Brent cargoes are traded on a paper, or forward market until the 1700 London time deadline on the nearest trading day 15 days before their assigned loading date.
A trading company is clocked when it is left with a paper cargo which has turned physical after that deadline and therefore cannot be passed on as part of pre-sold paper cargo deals.
